description: Closed-loop sensorless FOC. Below the 150 rad/s handoff the observer never converges and the run ends in ST_STALL.
notes: Startup authority 0.5 A; sl_handoff is 150 rad/s el, above this target.

title: Sensorless FOC (closed loop), 101 rad/s el — stalls
